sources.title: Layout Detection | Xberg
sources.snippet: Layout detection now populates ExtractedDocument.formulas for formula regions and supports chart understanding via enable_chart_understanding. With the opt-in formula-recognition cargo feature, formula regions can also run through a dedicated LaTeX recognition model.
